_about: Criterion constants transcribed from the published papers, for cross-checking crate constants. Angles in degrees, crescent width W in arcminutes. See docs/validation.md.

yallop_1997.source: Yallop, B.D. (1997), NAO Technical Note No. 69, 'A Method for Predicting the First Sighting of the New Crescent Moon', eqs (3.1)-(3.10), (4.1), (6.1) and Table 5. PDF: https://www.astronomycenter.net/pdf/yallop_1997.pdf
yallop_1997.width: SD = 0.27245 * parallax (eq 3.8 with column 14 note); SD' = SD * (1 + sin(h) * sin(parallax)) (eq 3.9, h = geocentric lunar altitude); W' = SD' * (1 - cos ARCL) (eq 3.10)
yallop_1997.best_time: Tb = Ts + (4/9) * Lag (eq 4.1), Ts = sunset, Lag = moonset - sunset
yallop_1997.arcl_relation: cos ARCL = cos ARCV * cos DAZ (eq 2.1)

categories.text: May need optical aid to find crescent
Will need optical aid to find crescent
Not visible with a telescope, ARCL <= 8.5 deg
Not visible, below Danjon limit, ARCL <= 8 deg

yallop_1997.category_A_note: Yallop derives the A/B limit (+0.216) from ARCL = 12, DAZ = 0 using the geocentric constant-semidiameter width W of eq (3.4), not W'.

historical_criteria.eq_3_4_bruin_width: W = 15 * (1 - cos ARCL) = 15 * (1 - cos ARCV * cos DAZ)

odeh_2004.source: Odeh, M.Sh. (2004), 'New criterion for lunar crescent visibility', Experimental Astronomy 18:39-64, doi:10.1007/s10686-005-9002-5, eq (2), Tables IV and V. PDF copy: http://bruneiastronomy.org/web/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/New_Criterion_Crescent.pdf
odeh_2004.v_definition: V = ARCV - (-0.1018*W^3 + 0.7319*W^2 - 6.3226*W + 7.1651), ARCV airless topocentric (deg), W topocentric width (arcmin)

Not visible even by optical aid

saao_table_iv.source_note: SAAO criterion (Caldwell and Laney 2001) as reproduced in Odeh (2004) Table IV. DALT = apparent altitude of the Moon's lower limb at sunset.
